For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of SSP STF A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Technical Specifications 9mm Sub Machine Gun Sl. N Parameter Specification o. 1. Caliber 9 mm x 19 mm 2. Ammunition Type The weapon (SMG) should be capable of flawlessly firing MIL (formerly known as OFB) manufactured 9x19mm ammunition. As well as it shou ld be capable to fire 9x19mm ammunition made by other Indian OEM’ s such as PLR SYSTEMS (INDIA) LIMITED, HUGHES PRECISION MANUFA CTURING Pvt. Ltd., STUMPP SCHUELE CASINGS PVT LTD. 3. Length Overall length (in open/extended butt position) should not be more tha n 720 mm. 4. Weight weight without magazine however with three picatinny rails should not be more than 3 kg. 5. Firing mode (a) Single and Automatic (b) Suitable change lever to select firing mode (c) Change lever should be positively locked to ensure that weapon fi res in desired mode only when it is in designated position.

6. Rate of Fire Should have the capability to fire minimum 800 rounds per minute. 7. Effective range The weapon should be able to effectively engage target at a range of 100 mtrs with aimed fire under normal condition of visibility. 8. Accuracy (a) At 50 mtrs (single shot) - Group size should be within 12.5 cms x 1 2.5 cms. (b) At 50 mtrs (short burst of two-three round)- All the rounds fired sho uld hit within 30 cm x 30 cm area. 9. Environmental C onditions -40 degrees C to +55 degrees C (a) Operatin -40 degrees C to +50 degrees C g Tempera ture 95% RH at 25 degrees C (b) Storage T The OEM shall submit an undertaking confirming compliance with the emperatur Environmental Conditions requirement. e (c) Humidity 10. Reliability (a) 1200 rounds test will be carried out. (b) The weapon should not suffer more than six Class-I stoppages in t otal. No class- II and Class-III stoppages. (i) Class-I stoppage- Can be removed by the firer within 10 se conds without the use of any tools/equipment spares by using only immediate action drills. (ii) Class-II stoppage- Can be removed by the firer in 10 second s to 10 minutes using tools/equipment, spares issued with the weapon. (iii) Class-III stoppage- Takes more than 10 minutes or special t ools/equipment to rectify defects and resume firing. 11. Adverse condition t (a) Sand Test est (b) Water Immersion Test (c) Drop Test 12. Magazine (a) Capacity- should have a magazine of minimum 30-round capacit y. (b) Material- Magazine should be either metallic with side slots to a mmunition indication or see through high strength polymer/compo site magazine. Magazine should be robust enough to withstand ro ugh usage under various environmental conditions. Should not get deformed when subjected to heat during prolonged firing or in hot weather conditions. 13. visible round count The magazine of the weapon should facilitate the visible round count. 14. Fore Hand Grip Fore hand grip should be present in the carbine

15. Safety Both mechanical & applied safety 16. Flip Up Sights Should have mechanical flip up sights 17. Picatinny Rail MIL standard 1913 picatinny rail integrated with the weapon on at leas t 3 side to provide interfaces for accessories like internationally availa ble optical sights and tactical lights/LAD. 18. Sling Carbine should have adjustable and robust carrying sling with quick de tachment feature. 19. Colour Black 20. Designed for right The weapon should be capable of ambidextrous usage. & left-handed use 21. Field Stopping Weapon should be easily striped without any tool or with minimum to ol & all cleaning parts to be designated for field cleaning. 22. Barrel life Barrel life should be minimum 15000 rounds. The OEM shall submit an undertaking confirming compliance with this requirement. 23. Shelf life The weapon shall have a minimum shelf life of 15 years. The OEM shal l submit an undertaking confirming compliance with this requirement. 24. Warranty Warranty for a period of 2 years. The OEM shall submit an undertaking confirming compliance with the warranty requirement. 25. Accessories Manufacturer should provide accessories to include: 1. Magazine- Two with each weapon 2. Field Cleaning Kit- One for each weapon 3. Sling- One for each weapon 4. Standard Weapon Tool Kit- one per 10 weapon 5. Feeler Gauge- (QTY- 2) 6. Headspace Gauges (Go & No Go)- (QTY- 2) 7. Firing Pin Protrusion Gauge (QTY- 2) 8. Rigid waterproof case for transit of weapon- One for each weap on 9. User and Maintenance, repair manual 10. Identification list with parts picture and cat part number 26. Training In situ training for one week on operation, maintenance, fault finding a nd user level repair at buyer’s premises to be provided by seller.

27. Testing The weapon shall be tested on the basis of the QR/TD issued by the Mi nistry of Home Affairs (MHA) vide its communication dated 27-05-2025 . Note- OEM/Bidder should upload technical Specification compliance on their letter head. . 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
